page_title: MET 2-3 PSG | Metz v PSG 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' Koffi Kouao (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Romain Lissorgue had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ibrahim Mbaye as he is replaced by Lucas Beraldo (PSG).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Metz force their opponents to concede a corner.
87' Metz string together a series of short passes.
85' Today's match ends for Boubacar Traore who will be replaced by Alpha Toure (Metz).
85' Stephane Le Mignan decides to make a substitution. Malick Mbaye will be replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
85' The game has come to an end for Georgiy Tsitaishvili. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz).
85' A substitution has been made. Jessy Deminguet (Metz) is replaced by Benjamin Stambouli.
81' 2 - 3 Goal - 2:3! Gauthier Hein laid the ball off to Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

78' Bradley Barcola (PSG) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.

76' Gauthier Hein (Metz) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) was quite harsh and Romain Lissorgue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
74' It is time for a substitution. Sadibou Sane (Metz) is on for Terry Yegbe.
72' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

72' The ball is laid off to Desire Doue (PSG) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the right side of the goal and forces Jonathan Fischer to make a decent save. It will be a corner kick for PSG.
71' OFF THE WOODWORK! Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
69' A pass by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
69' Metz enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' Substitution. Goncalo Ramos makes way for Bradley Barcola (PSG).
66' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Quentin Ndjantou is replaced by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).
63' 1 - 3 Desire Doue (PSG) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Jonathan Fischer with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:3.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
62' Koffi Kouao (Metz) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Matvey Safonov was alert and made a comfortable save. Metz get a corner.
62' Metz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
59' Habib Diallo (Metz) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
57' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) tackles a bit over-zealously and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
55' Kang-In Lee (PSG) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
54' Kang-In Lee (PSG) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
52' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
51' Great save! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Jonathan Fischer.
49' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
46' Substitution. Fabian Ruiz is replaced by Desire Doue (PSG).
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+7' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Some patient build-up play from PSG as they look to unlock the defence.

42' 1 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Jessy Deminguet (Metz) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a strong shot into the top of the net. His attempt was beyond the reach of Matvey Safonov, so the score changes to 1:2.
42' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Habib Diallo (Metz) inside the box.
39' 0 - 2 Goal! Ibrahim Mbaye feeds Quentin Ndjantou (PSG), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:2.
37' Kang-In Lee (PSG) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
36' Total attempts – 1:3.
33' Great teamplay by Metz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

31' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) bravely launches himself at a cross from Kang-In Lee and gives Jonathan Fischer no chance with a close-range bullet header into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
31' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
29' PSG are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

27' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
26' Boubacar Traore (Metz) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. PSG win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
24' Metz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Terry Yegbe (Metz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
20' Kang-In Lee (PSG) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick.

17' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Jonathan Fischer pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
16' Malick Mbaye (Metz) has tested the patience of referee Romain Lissorgue and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
15' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. PSG are awarded the free kick.
13' Kang-In Lee (PSG) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
10' PSG are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
8' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
6' Habib Diallo (Metz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
3' Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Metz will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Romain Lissorgue.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
